# Frozen Cedar author output

`references/` preserves the exact Cedar files from source commit `b8bd05bd6a0462cac4f6a215ac55d6b25f01c5bc`, before the requirements-browser retirement migration. `frozen-sha256.json` records every file hash. The inherited provenance also records the five HTML copy hashes and both input hashes.

These bytes are historical evidence, outside the built app. Their original retired element and hidden bodies remain intact. The current examples in `experiments/agent-written/cedar-documents/` have a separate retirement migration; their result is not the original author outcome. The existing formatter ignores reference artifacts, preserving the exact source bytes.
